title: attendance.clock_out
description: Clock out the session user. Closes the running break, if any. Location fields are optional and recorded as reported.

lat.description: Latitude of the device when clocking out. Null when location is not required.

lng.description: Longitude of the device when clocking out. Null when location is not required.

accuracy_m.description: Accuracy of the position reported by the device, in metres.

distance_m.description: Distance to the workplace measured by the client (Haversine), in metres.

within_radius.description: 1 when the client measured the device inside the workplace radius, 0 outside, null when not measured.
